beginner.title: Get started with MSD Manual

beginner.outcome: You can: understand strength of evidence

intermediate.title: Drugs and calculations
intermediate.outcome: You can: check doses and interactions safely

intermediate.title: Use on mobile
intermediate.outcome: You can: use MSD Manual quickly on a phone

intermediate.outcome: You can: use the features that make MSD Manual distinctive

expert.title: Advanced MSD Manual
expert.outcome: You can: use MSD Manual's advanced capabilities with confidence

expert.title: Teach and audit with it
expert.outcome: You can: use MSD Manual for teaching and CPD

expert.title: Integrate MSD Manual into your workflow
expert.outcome: You can: connect MSD Manual with the other tools you use
